title: The Long Dark
working_title: History Before Time: The Long Dark
logline: When the load-shedding South Africa learned to live with finally stops coming back on — petrol going to gum, diesel on a one-year clock, the taps drying behind dead pumps — a sixty-year-old fixer who spent his whole life ready for exactly this leads a handful of strangers out of a dying city and into the high country, to prove, in the year he will die, the thing the world keeps forgetting: that when the lights go out, most people reach for each other, not each other's throats.
blueprint: grounded present-day collapse-survival — the 4th Jakobus-Book; The Knowledge (accurate-collapse) × Humankind (anti-Lord-of-the-Flies thesis) × the Sheltering-Desert real-bushcraft register; carries Jakobus's locked 2030 death + claims the Wake at the Beast as coda
market: grounded survival / book-club literary thriller — the South African load-shedding present taken one honest step further; the propulsive, broad-appeal sibling of the quiet Jakobus backstory volumes
